verdicts.reasoning: Reproduced with the real release payload (card v0.21.14). The self-install path is live: src/ui/editor/install.ts:154 -> src/host/install.ts:75-79 -> core/install.ts installLore, which creates the ⚙️설정 folder with a random key `folder:<uuid>` (install.ts:266) and puts Directory / Plugin manifest in that folder. The card payload's same entries carry the card's fixed folder key (folder:f3b3863b-...). planUpdate (update.ts:185) pairs entries by loreName = comment + folder (update.ts:108): the folder entry itself has no `folder` so it pairs and is REPLACED by the card's (its key changes to the card's key), while Directory and Plugin manifest have different `folder` values, so the card's copies are 'added' and the user's are 'kept' at the end. PROTECTED_LORE never fires (count.protected = 0). readDirectoryData (world/directory.ts:295-296) joins the content of ALL Directory entries with '\n' and parses -> two JSON objects -> null. manifestEntry now returns the card's manifest first, so the user's planted greeting index is orphaned. CARD_FIELDS loop (update.ts:203-207) then overwrites desc/personality/scenario/systemPrompt/... with the card's empty strings, alternateGreetings with [""], triggerscript with [] - the user's own bot content is lost on setCharacterToIndex (ui/update.ts:284). A second update: renamed() line 133 keeps only the first Directory (the card default), silently dropping the user's edited roster. The gate does not prevent this: ui/update.ts newVersions/updateGroup only check readManifest != null (true for self-installed bots), and buildManifest keeps `prev.version ?? PLUGIN_VERSION` (install.ts:197), so the 'new card version' banner appears on every release for these users. Not dead code, not taste, no owner decision contradicted (header comment of update.ts itself promises 사용자가 고친 명부는 지킨다). verdicts.reasoning:
The finding is half real. Severity should be low, not medium.

**Real part — the icon comes back after the user reverted it.**
- `restoreIcon` deletes the icon record for the character (`src/host/install.ts:195`).
- `checkInstall` then computes `iconOurs` as false because there is no record (`:63`), so `s.icon` is false.
- The 'all' step in `installAction` reinstalls the icon whenever `s.icon` is false (`src/ui/editor/install.ts:162`). Nothing remembers that the user chose the old icon.
- Because `allDone` requires `s.icon` (`:81`), the button stays the highlighted 「빠진 것 전부 채우기」 after a revert, which invites the press.
- The same press is what the page tells users to do to resume pictures (`:94`), so the scenario is plausible.

**Why only low.**
- Nothing is lost: `installIcon` records the previous icon again (`:168`), so 「이전 아이콘으로」 works again.
- It is not silent: the result line lists 「아이콘」 among the things done.

**Rejected part — the wording mismatch is intended.**
- `installSummary` leaving the icon out of the missing count is deliberate. `tests/qc-loader-browser.mjs:626` says 「아이콘은 점검 항목이지만 빠진 것 수에는 안 셈」 and `:662` expects 「모두 갖춰져 있어요 … (아이콘만 다름)」.
- The all-button installing the icon on an already-installed card with no record is also pinned (`:630`).
- So the reporter's proposals to add an icon line to `installSummary`, or to change the official-card behaviour, contradict pinned behaviour and should not be applied.

verdicts.reasoning:

확인된 것:

- getText(src/host/datapack.ts:34-48)는 risuFetch 40초 + nativeFetch 40초다. 응답이 멈춘 환경에서는 최악 80초가 걸린다.
- openInstall(src/ui/app.ts:804)은 `await refreshInstall(installCtx)` 뒤에야 openEditor를 부른다. 그동안 설치 창이 뜨지 않는다. ensureInstallData는 저장된 자료가 있으면 네트워크 없이 끝나므로, 이 대기는 v0.21.11 이후 새로 생긴 것이다.
- 「전부 채우기」 한 번에 checkInstall이 두 번 돈다(installPictures 101행, 끝의 refreshInstall 174행). 처음 창을 열 때까지 합치면 세 번이다.

제보에서 깎이는 것:
- 「없음」으로 보아 다시 받게 하는 것은 65행 주석대로 11-13 전수검사에서 일부러 넣은 동작이다. 「전부 채우기」를 한 번 누르면 받고 지문이 적혀 해소된다. 기능이 깨지는 것이 아니라 글이 사실과 다른 것이다.
- 80초 대기는 응답이 멈추는 환경에서만 생긴다. 보통 환경에서는 작은 JSON 한 번이다.
- src/ui/editor/manage.ts:140은 storedWikiPack()만 보므로 영향이 없다.

그래서 심각도는 low 그대로다.

verdicts.reasoning:
Confirmed by reading the code; I found no guard that refutes it.

- Both checks are plain inequality. `fetchBody` uses `index?.version !== version`; `fetchPack` uses `index.hash !== pack.expect.hash`. Neither looks at which side is newer, and both end with 「아직 이 판의 …가 올라오지 않았어요. 잠시 뒤 다시 받아 주세요.」
- The release folder holds only one version. `release/goei-body.json` and `release/goei-data-world.json` each carry a single `version` (0.21.14 now). Once the release moves past the installed plugin, the condition is true forever and 「다시 받기」 can never succeed.
- No nearby text points to the real remedy. The loader panel (`src/loader/panel.ts`) and the world-data panel (`src/host/datapanel.ts`) only say to retry or insert a file from the release zip. Following the zip advice with the latest zip then fails with 「이 플러그인(…)과 맞는 goei-body.js가 아니에요」.
- The lazily fetched packs make this reachable for ordinary users. Besides world and install data, `fetchPack` serves `ITEMS_PACK` (`src/host/itemicons.ts:59`), `LOOKS_PACK` (`src/host/looks.ts:47`) and `HOMESHOP_PACK` (`src/host/homeshop.ts:78`). These are fetched on first use, so a user who stays on an old plugin and opens that screen for the first time after a newer release hits it. The body and world data are normally already in pluginStorage, so those two only fail after storage is cleared.

Mitigations exist, which keeps severity low: the build writes `//@update-url` (`scripts/build.mjs:17`), and `src/ui/update.ts:152,183` shows a new-plugin notice once the body is running. The user can still decline or miss those, and the message itself stays misleading.

No unit test pins the current behaviour as intended. `tests/qc-loader-browser.mjs:938` pins the 「올라오지 않았어요」 text only for a changed hash with the same version, which a fix must preserve.

Two corrections to the reporter's fix sketch:
- `src/loader/body.ts` is the small loader bundle. Importing `compareVersions` from `src/core/update.ts` would drag in lorebooks, directory and install modules, so it needs a dependency-free module instead.
